title: storage/public forms: an anonymous public-form submission cannot carry a file — `/storage/upload` answers 404 to the guest principal, so a required attachment field is impossible on a public form
body:
Ruled: 6377887908 · batch #9 item 1 (#25496, 6377842908) · letter B · 2026-10-24T00:43:45Z (ADR-0138 guest-upload addendum first, implementation after it lands)

Filed from the objectstack-ai/hotsrm v0.1 platform evaluation, 2026-10-23, spec 18.0.0.

## What was measured
- Anonymous submission through a public form works: forged `status`, `supplier`, `duplicate_check` and `owner` values are stripped, the record flow fires.
- A file field needs an existing `sys_file` id. `POST /storage/upload` returns 404 for the guest principal, so no public form can take an attachment, and a `required` file field makes the form unsubmittable.
- Supplier registration in China needs the business licence scan on the first contact; the app had to move the upload to after the portal account exists, which changes the registration process the customer signs off on.

## Wanted
- A guest upload door bound to the public form: the file is accepted only for the form's declared file fields, size and type limited by the field, stored unattached under the form's organisation (ADR-0138 D4), and either attached by the submission that follows or garbage-collected after a short TTL if no submission arrives.
- The same anti-abuse posture as the form itself (rate limit per address, no listing, no read-back of other guests' files).

## Acceptance
A public form with a required file field can be submitted by an anonymous visitor; the record is created with the attachment; an upload that is never followed by a submission disappears after the TTL.

Dedupe words: public form guest anonymous file upload storage/upload 404 required file field attachment TTL.
